Income Tax & Salary Planning India

Plan Indian income tax for salaried earners — new vs old regime basics, GST tools, and free salary tax calculator.

Salaried Indians compare the new and old tax regimes, track TDS, and file ITR on time. Rules change with Union Budgets — always verify against official sources for the current FY.

Frequently asked questions

Is the salary tax calculator official?

No. It is an educational estimate for planning. Final tax depends on your full income, deductions, and current Finance Act rules.

New vs old tax regime — which should I choose?

It depends on your deductions and income mix. Use a calculator for estimates, then confirm with current Finance Act rules or a tax professional.

When should salaried people file ITR?

File before the official deadline for the assessment year even if tax is fully TDS-paid — it helps refunds, loans and record-keeping.
